title: Analyst Forecasting Ability and the Stock Price Reaction to Forecast Revisions

work/runtime/20261118T052814502940Z/build.lst, aggregate date-coverage output: Detail and linked Detail reach 31DEC2002; annual-primary Summary History reaches 19DEC2002; standardized annual fundamentals and successful dated security links reach 31DEC2002; scored analyst history reaches 30DEC1999; Compustat annual-actual RDQ reaches 19MAR2008; event RDQ and CRSP dividends cover through 15JAN2000; CRSP daily/index returns and daily/monthly GBP cross-rates cover through 31DEC2002.
The assigned sample, model and predecessor records were checked by the controller against task.json hashes; this replay used only the assigned reconstruction route and the named local source tables.
changes: Extended the observation end from 1994 to 1999 and widened construction input bounds through 2002; earnings, dividend and confounder event feeds extend through 15 January 2000.

Applied the unchanged five-broker and fiscal-year-end stability logic across pooled support years 1988–1999; retained the two-calendar-year analyst-ability lookback, event windows, pooled OLS terms and conventional covariance.
Added aggregate-only source date-range diagnostics and a Stata e(sample) count. The diagnostic failed because ACTDATS was uppercase in the SAS-to-Stata handoff; no second scientific launch was made.
limitations: The final best-effort baseline produces 4,223 observations versus 15,446 in Table 4. Of 50,965 analyst-classified events before confounder and market-data screens, 45,946 overlap another revision, 7,307 overlap earnings announcements, 5,351 overlap dividend declarations, one lacks the full return window, and two lack the t−2 price; these counts overlap. The overlap screen is the largest measured loss, but aggregate diagnostics do not establish the cause of the paper-sample difference.

The pooled OLS slopes and pairwise tests differ materially from the published values. The full comparison, construction choices, repairs and diagnostics are documented in design.md and review.md; no sample or transformation was tuned toward published estimates.
The source does not define whether a consensus mean or median is used; Summary History MEDEST is used as a documented best-effort choice.

The source does not identify an event key for combining simultaneous revisions across forecast horizons. Distinct Detail rows are treated separately; exact duplicate rows are measured and same-time multi-horizon cardinality is reported.

The local I/B/E/S product has 218 zero ANALYS codes among 3,463,076 Detail EPS rows. Such rows are not assigned to an analyst-firm track record and remain individual unknown revisions for conservative confound screening.

The source does not report whether the analyst ability consensus is a mean or median, does not define an event key for collapsing simultaneous horizon revisions, and does not specify the availability cutoff for actual earnings. MEDEST, distinct changed Detail rows, and RDQ on or before the event are documented best-effort choices.
The source does not specify return-compounding/index details or a covariance correction. The build uses compounded CRSP value-weighted market returns and conventional pooled OLS covariance.

This pooled build produced 10 final regression rows (event years 1991–1995, 1997 and 1999); aggregate eligibility counts show 1 broker-eligible GVKEY across the 1988–1999 support window, 318 Compustat-linked revision candidates, 94 events with ability scores, and 10 after confounder/market screens. The stricter extended support window materially changes the sample relative to the predecessor 1990–1994 build (4,223 rows), so its sample-size difference is not attributable to source date coverage alone.

The Stata regression ran with N=10 and emitted a partial coefficient table, then aborted with r(111) because the diagnostic used lowercase actdats while the handoff field is ACTDATS. The three pairwise tests, required original/added e(sample) counts, last-added marker and four aggregate table exports were not completed. The controller launch was not repeated.
The local source ranges support the requested 1999 extension, but this scope is marked failed because the native Stata stage did not complete and the required period-specific fit evidence is absent.
